name: GJH Can — South Africa Abalone (Codex flat label)
summary: Comparison variant of the South Africa abalone can whose label is an AI-generated flat artwork (Codex image generation), similar in look to the official packaging.
description: Same can geometry as the photo-unrolled version, with a wrap-around label from an AI-generated flat artwork made from the official packshots. Crisper and free of photo seams, but its text, seals and codes are not guaranteed to match the official label.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Deterministic Blender Python geometry (same as the photo version). Label texture is an AI-generated flat label (Codex built-in image generation, prompt and inputs recorded in label_source); not official artwork.
accuracy_notes: Same nominal dimensions as the photo version (diameter 73.5 mm; height from the measured label rows). The label is AI-generated and not official; see label_source for known differences. Real dimensions are unverified.

attribution.credit: Label artwork unrolled from GJH eShop official packshots recorded in Webpage-Design-Gallery assets/companies/gjh/official (manifest.json). Can geometry is original.

rights: AI-generated reference artwork inspired by GJH / New Moon packaging; trademarks and product names belong to their owners. Used in the owner's project on the owner's confirmation; no independent licence document was supplied. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.

label_source.status: Not official artwork. Text, numbers, seals, QR codes and barcodes may differ from the official label; do not rely on it for claims.
label_source.generator: OpenAI Codex CLI built-in image generation (image_gen), prompted with the official eShop packshots listed under product.reference_images
label_source.layout: left to right: picture/food face, front face, information face; wraps around the can
known_discrepancies_from_official: The extra crown seal and star seal were removed in a second Codex pass.
The remaining award mark (gold trophy, PREMIUM BRAND WINNER) and the Halal/award marks are generic designs, not the official marks.
QR code and barcode were redrawn by the model and were not verified or scanned.
label_source.revision: Second pass: invented crown and star seals removed.
